name: AgriBase land-use input used in the 2006 CLUES work
description: A September 2003 AgriBase input used in the CLUES land-use mapping work and harmonised with LCDB2.
story: The July 2006 CLUES Stage II report identifies the AgriBase source layer as dated September 2003. It was combined with LCDB2, MAF Monitor Farm information and LENZ in a national land-use map for the modelling framework.

The report notes that AgriBase and LCDB2 disagreed in some locations. The method retained AgriBase classifications only where they were consistent with LCDB2 and otherwise used LCDB2. This is a dated model input and harmonisation choice, distinct from the December 2000 AgriBase snapshot catalogued elsewhere.
